parsed.internal_thinking: Shon is offering me 1 sheep for 1 brick. Looking at my resources, I have 1 brick, 1 wood, and 1 sheep. I need the brick and wood to build a road toward node 32, which is a high-priority expansion for me. Shon just rolled an 11, which gave him a wood (from node 30, hex 9). If I accept this trade, he will have wheat, sheep, wood, and brick—exactly what he needs to build a settlement. Since he mentioned wanting to build at the port, and I'm competing with him for board space, it's not in my interest to help him settle right now, especially when I gain nothing useful (I already have a sheep and no immediate use for a second one without a port).
parsed.note_to_self: Shon is one brick away from a settlement. I must be careful not to trade him the final piece he needs to box me in. My priority is reaching node 32.
parsed.say_outloud: לא הפעם שון, אני חייב לשמור את הלבנה הזאת כדי לנסות להתקדם קצת בעצמי. ה-11 הזה לא נתן לי כלום ואני חייב לשמור על המשאבים שלי.
